posts.cooked:
Looking awful familiar here....  (Nitpick:  Staff of Ra increases all damage by Ra, not just fire damage.)

"Your sacrifice is appreciated, Old Kid.  Now to remind Young Kid what a real hero looks like."

The Argent Adept.

HP: 14

Hand:  Cedistic Dissonant, Vernal Sonata, Inspiring Supertonic

In Play:   Drake's Pipes

Trash:  Polyphoric Flare

------------------------------------------

Start of Turn: 3 damage from Treacherous Ape.

Play a Card:  Cedistic Dissonant

Use a Power:  Vocalize Cedistic - destroy Drake's Pipes to nuke the Dark Hero.

Draw a Card:  Instrumental Conjuration

End of Turn:

-------------------------------------------------------

HP: 11

Hand:   Vernal Sonata, Inspiring Supertonic, Instrumental Conjuration

In Play:  Cedistic Dissonant

Trash: Polyphoric Flare, Drake's Pipes

Effects:

I vote that the Toy Master got hit, since I was always going to play an Ongoing this turn anyway.  Also when Shamise dies, Tempest should get the Rod since he doesn't have an innate damage power...it'll be redundant if he plays Grevious Hail Storm, but he's still the best candidate to hold the rod other than possibly Argent, who currently has little use for his Power phase, but aspires to eventually change that (if he doesn't die first).

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Uh, if you are talking about the advanced text for Dreamer then we have an issue, because the first round I would have done 1 instead of 2 damage and stun bolt wouldn't have gotten through reduction at all.

The illusory demons would have been at 4 after I shot them, stun bolt wouldn't have done anything and Ra would have reduced it to 2hp instead of killing it.  Shamise would drop it to 1hp and it would be alive for the villain turn.

We didn't apply the reduction the entire first round.
